packageRules.description: Automatically merge GitHub Actions dependency updates after Renovate observes green CI.

agent-desktop is built by this repository's own pipeline. Its pin lives in devcontainer-compose-pins.yml, outside the CI image path filter, so merging a bump cannot retrigger the build that produced the digest and bump itself again. That is what makes automerge safe here.

Super-Linter and the pre-commit/local tools it pins (Prettier, clang-format, Ansible Lint, Hadolint, Ruff, ShellCheck, Gitleaks, Actionlint, Zizmor) must stay in sync with the pinned Super-Linter image. Update them manually with the sync-super-linter-tool-versions skill instead.
Prettier's additional_dependencies pin in the mirrors-prettier hook is synced manually alongside the mirror revision; see the rule above.

The provisioning tools the Ansible roles pin (uv, Yarn, the agent CLIs, fisher, bass). Each pin is a bare version string with nothing that has to move with it, so a bump cannot leave the role half-updated the way the checksum-carrying pins in dev_tools would. That is what makes batching and automerge safe here.

uv is pinned twice: the setup-python-venv action input CI runs on, and the uv_setup role the image ships. Grouping them keeps both in one PR so CI never validates against a different uv than the image carries.

customManagers.description: Version pins in the Ansible roles' defaults, each tagged by a `# renovate:` comment on the line above it.
Commit pins in the Ansible roles' defaults, for upstreams whose tags are unusable. The comment carries the branch the commit is tracked on.
